target_customer: Merchants, restaurants, retailers and marketplaces that need same-day local delivery without running their own fleet
problem: Businesses wanting local delivery must integrate many courier networks and handle late or missing deliveries one by one.
business_model: Usage-based delivery orchestration API and software, with a courier network

founders.name: Mahmoud Ghulman
previous_startups: Gig-worker parking logistics company (outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: Led business development at Mozn per the YC page.

founders.name: Aziz Alghunaim
education: MIT, bachelor's and master's in computer science (2015)
founders.background_notes: Software engineer at Palantir per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating many courier APIs, routing and tracking is mostly standard engineering with hard operational edge cases.

defensibility.rationale: Courier integrations and customer workflows create some lock-in, but couriers and rivals offer similar APIs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Delivery networks like Uber were partners that Nash plugs into per its 2022 blog; no copy or acquisition found through 2026.

market_need_then: Post-pandemic growth of local delivery and small businesses wanting to match Amazon speed, per a16z (July 2022).

branding.domain_note: Started on usenash.com and moved to nash.ai (301 redirect seen in 2026); docs still on usenash.com

rebrands.why: Not stated; domain change observed by redirect only

brand_strength.rationale: Short name but shared with several other products called Nash; no sources on community or brand assets.

outcome_analysis: Nash raised an a16z-led 7.8 million dollar seed in late 2021 and a 20 million dollar Series A in July 2022, totaling 27.8 million dollars, and claimed 52 percent average month-over-month revenue growth over the prior year. It is still operating and repositioned to AI logistics by 2026. No later round was found, so growth since 2022 is unverified.
notes: Seed amount and Series A confirmed on the company blog (dated July 25, 2022) and a16z post (July 26, 2022, no amount); aggregator seed figures differ (9M on one). Competitor search returned only 2024 to 2026 comparison pages for Onfleet, Bringg, Tookan and Shipday, none dated near the 2021 batch, so the list is left empty rather than dated wrongly. a16z and the company blog name no competitors. No Series B, layoffs or acquisition found.
